_note: Synthetic data created for an interview exercise. Not real patients.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hi Tom, what's been going on?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Got laid off in June. Since then I've been low, not sleeping, snapping at my wife over nothing.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: High blood pressure, controlled with lisinopril.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Tom, your scores are 17 and 12. Blood pressure being controlled is fine for our purposes but I'll want it checked in your weekly check-ins.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: I'm going to use a 100mg troche for you, starting at a quarter of that.

notes.clinical_summary: 52M, depressive episode following job loss. PHQ 17 / GAD 12. Hypertension controlled on lisinopril.
notes.plan: Approve. 100mg troche, start 25mg. Weekly BP readings in check-in. 30-day supply.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Tom, you're doing well - 17 down to 11, anxiety 12 to 8. Blood pressure readings look stable.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'm running again. Wife says I'm easier to live with.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: You've settled at 60mg split into two doses. Any reason to change it?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: I'll renew for five shipments. Book with me before those run out.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Will do. Money's a bit tight, but I'll manage.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: If cost becomes an issue, talk to the Care Team before you stop - there may be options.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: [note to file] Good responder at 60mg split. If he lapses and returns after a gap, restart titration from the standard quarter dose rather than resuming 60 directly - do not assume prior tolerance carries over. He raised cost; flag retention risk.

notes.clinical_summary: Sustained response at 8 weeks. PHQ 17->11, GAD 12->8. Stable BP. Settled on 60mg split dosing.
notes.plan: Renew prescription: 100mg troche, 5 refills. Continue 60mg split. On any return after a treatment gap, restart titration from quarter dose. Cost flagged as retention risk.
